concept_html:
Two tools catch most mistakes before a test runs.

ruff lints and formats. On a ten-line sample it reported three real problems:

m.py:1:1: I001 [*] Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted
m.py:1:8: F401 [*] `os` imported but unused
m.py:9:30: B905 `zip()` without an explicit `strict=` parameter

B905 matters for data work: zip(flags, weights) silently stops at the shorter list, so a missing weight drops a respondent without an error. zip(..., strict=True) raises instead.

mypy checks types. On the same file, strict mode found:

m.py:14: error: Unsupported operand types for * ("None" and "int")  [operator]
m.py:17: error: Function is missing a type annotation  [no-untyped-def]

Line 14 multiplies a float | None by 100. When the total weight is zero, the function returns None and the report crashes. mypy found the zero-weight bug without any test data.

Daily habits:

  • Configure both once in pyproject.toml ([tool.ruff] with the rule sets you want, [tool.mypy] with strict = true).
  • Run ruff check --fix . and ruff format . before each commit. --fix applies only safe fixes.
  • Run mypy on src/ and tests/. Fix errors by handling the case, not by adding # type: ignore.
  • Run the same commands in CI (lesson A10-L3), so the rules are not optional.

Libraries without type information show import-untyped or missing-stub notes. Install the stub package if one exists, or add a targeted [[tool.mypy.overrides]] with ignore_missing_imports = true for that module only.

lines: def weighted_share(flags: list[int], weights: list[float]) -> float | None:
"""Weighted share of flagged rows, or None when the total weight is 0."""
total = sum(weights)
if total == 0:
return None
return sum(w for f, w in zip(flags, weights, strict=True) if f == 1) / total
def report(flags: list[int], weights: list[float]) -> str:
"""Share as a percentage string, or 'n/a' when undefined."""
share = weighted_share(flags, weights)
if share is None:
return "n/a"
return f"{share * 100:.1f}%"

title: ruff and mypy in daily work
why_html:
A reporting script formats a weighted share as f"{share * 100:.1f}%". For eleven months every subgroup has respondents. Then a new region with no fieldwork yet appears in the sample frame, its total weight is zero, weighted_share returns None, and the monthly client pack fails to build on deadline day.

mypy flags None * 100 the first time it runs on the file. The fix is two lines, written months before the failure.
